The necessary-not-sufficient framing is present and specific, naming DR-119 and DR-117/DR-128 for CA-2 and the per-subtype slice authorities for CA-3, and its DR-108 claim checks out against D-002's deferral. turn2Findings.ADV-D032-T2-01: LANDED-VERIFIED (repair present; original finding text unseen). The review prompt characterizes this as a MUST-FIX on BLK-3. The turn-2 draft read 'BLK-3: DISCHARGED-AS-INAPPLICABLE for doctor-side records (they are grant-journal outcomes). RETAINED for component tails inside DR-105.' The turn-3 draft reads 'BLK-3: STILL-ROUTED. Not discharged. Host-side completed / not-performed / indeterminate outcomes are a mandatory minimum of the host-effect contract (clause 4). Component tails retain DR-105's grant-journal outcomes.' The repair is not merely a relabel: clause 4 now carries the corresponding obligation in the contract's own terms, and the Honesty section records the cost openly — 'BLK-3 stays open until the host-effect contract exists.' Checked against the blocker's full text, which requires that INDETERMINATE and COMPLETED-BEFORE-REVOCATION 'be disclosed as OUTCOMES' and forbids 'being modeled as refusals': the mandatory minimum's three-value outcome vocabulary is responsive to exactly that requirement.

objections.claim: BLK-6's disposition is scoped to 'host default reads', but the blocker names four DR-105 tokens of which one, FS-WRITE-HOST-STATE, is a write. That token is left undisposed by the scope word, and it is the one in tension with DR-114's read-only default.
objections.evidence: BLK-6's full text, read from the join verdict at 538f368156d22f96bf067dd9faad924610dd78ca16968ad46541efcf14a61344: 'Four DR-105 tokens (FS-READ-PROJECT, FS-READ-COMPONENT, FS-WRITE-HOST-STATE, ENV-READ) describe effects doctor performs in its UNCONSENTED default posture; doctor references none of them, so doctor's "default" is a permissioned action set under DR-105's tables while being ungated in doctor's.' Clause 5's disposition reads: 'BLK-6: DISCHARGED-AS-INAPPLICABLE for host default reads (host surface properties, not DR-105 grants). Doctor's no-silent-downgrade remains.' Three of the four tokens are reads; FS-WRITE-HOST-STATE is not, and the word 'reads' does not reach it. The Option B logic plausibly dissolves all four — if doctor's default acts are host acts they fall outside DR-105 whether they read or write — so this is a wording gap rather than a substantive hole. But it is not cosmetic, for two reasons. First, this entry's governing claim about clause 5 is that the blockers are 'named, not waved', and a disposition whose scope word omits a quarter of the named token set has not fully named it. Second, the omitted token is precisely the one that sits in tension with the acceptance evidence for DR-114 in file 08 at 5e1a75a5, which requires 'Read-only/no-code/no-network default tests': either doctor does not perform FS-WRITE-HOST-STATE in its unconsented default, in which case the blocker's premise fails for that token and the entry can say so and gain a stronger disposition, or it does, in which case 'reads' is the wrong scope word and the read-only default claim needs reconciling. The entry decides neither.
objections.proposedFix: Replace 'host default reads' with the token set, for example: 'DISCHARGED-AS-INAPPLICABLE for doctor's unconsented default acts, comprising all four named tokens FS-READ-PROJECT, FS-READ-COMPONENT, FS-WRITE-HOST-STATE and ENV-READ (host surface properties, not DR-105 grants).' If FS-WRITE-HOST-STATE is not in fact performed in the read-only default, say that instead and cite doctor v4, which is the stronger disposition.

whatIVerified: Subject digest at start and end: aa6c031510565f64fe310d6a63a04d60f6e987c34e91759ac5728a6b74c1c598 both times. No drift.

BLK-3 is not marked discharged, which is the axis the prompt names: 'BLK-3: STILL-ROUTED. Not discharged.' The word 'discharged' appears only in the negation. The routing has a destination and an obligation rather than being a parking label — clause 4's mandatory minimum requires 'a typed host-side outcome vocabulary covering completed, definitely-not-performed, and unknown/indeterminate outcomes (so host doctor does not silently drop the honesty BLK-3 asked of the join)'. Read against BLK-3's full text, which requires DR-105's INDETERMINATE and COMPLETED-BEFORE-REVOCATION 'be disclosed as OUTCOMES' and forbids them 'being modeled as refusals', the three-value outcome vocabulary is responsive on both halves. The Honesty section states the cost without softening it: 'BLK-3 stays open until the host-effect contract exists.'

Host-effect contract necessary-not-sufficient, the second named axis: present and specific rather than formulaic. Clause 4 states the contract 'is necessary, not sufficient for product admission' and then enumerates the additional gates — CA-2 also requires DR-119's approved-exception path and DR-117/DR-128 if the tool is third-party; CA-3 subtypes require their existing slice authorities. I checked the DR-108 claim, which is the concrete one: D-002's explicit deferrals include 'DR-108 (no credential-requiring features in slice 1)', and file 08's DR-108 row is OPEN and scoped as a hard blocker only for features requiring stored credentials. So 'DR-108 remains deferred; keychain probes stay unexercisable until DR-108 is in-slice' is accurate, and it matches BLK-2's own note that keychain is RESERVED because DR-108 is deferred.

terminationNote: No MUST-FIX survives, so nothing here parks this entry CONTESTED under the prompt's own rule. I cannot CONSENT because one SHOULD-FIX stands, and D-000 clause 2 forbids recording a forced consensus. I record for the coordinator's judgement that the surviving finding is a scope word in one disposition, that its correct replacement is supplied, and that both available repairs — enumerate the four tokens, or state that FS-WRITE-HOST-STATE is not performed in the read-only default and cite doctor v4 — would strengthen the disposition rather than weaken it. Across three turns this entry took two MUST-FIXes and two SHOULD-FIXes from me plus one MUST-FIX from Codex, and every one is repaired at bytes; the substantive choice, Option B with the measured component-tail split, has survived attack at every turn and I contest none of it.
